summary: Ji Chenxi (Quý Thần Hi) and his companion Shadow find themselves on a starship owned by Chi Zhuo (Trì Chước), who is accompanied by Nether, a middle-aged man, and a younger man. Chi Zhuo, still holding a grudge from a past encounter, confronts Ji Chenxi with photon cannons. Ji Chenxi, revealed to be the Third Prince, attempts to manipulate Chi Zhuo with a pitiful act, calling him "Brother Chi Zhuo" and feigning apology for past actions, while Chi Zhuo mockingly addresses him as "Your Highness." The tension escalates into a fight. Ji Chenxi unleashes his snow leopard spirit beast and uses pheromone-laced spiritual attacks to pin Chi Zhuo. However, Chi Zhuo reveals his own spirit beast, a black mamba, which coils around Ji Chenxi, creating a stalemate.
